name: YFCC100M
description: Yahoo Flickr Creative Commons 100M: about 99 million photos and 8 million videos with EXIF and tags. Tag mAP and geographic accuracy on slices. Thomee et al., Communications of the ACM 2016. Media stay under Flickr terms and are not vendored.
